<module id="pulse_detect">
	<description>Implements pulse detection logic for a single-bit input signal data_in.</description>
	
	<ports>
		<input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
		<input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
		
		<input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
		
		<output id="data_out">Output signal indicating detected pulses.</output>
	endports
	
	<implementation>State machine with 4 states to detect pulse transitions from 0 to 1 and back to 0.</implementation>
	
	<!-- State definitions -->
	<parameter id="idle">Initial state where data_in is 0.</parameter>
	<parameter id="detect">Detecting the first transition from 0 to 1.</parameter>
	<parameter id="wait">Waiting for the second transition from 1 to 0 after detecting the first one.</parameter>
	<parameter id="end">Final state where the pulse has been detected completely.</parameter>
	
	<!-- Declare internal registers and wires here -->
	reg [2:0] state;
	reg data_out;
	
	always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
	    // Synchronous reset and state transition logic
	    if (~rst_n) begin
	        state <= 'd0;
	        data_out <= 1'b0;
	    end else begin
	        case(state)
	            idle: begin
	                if(data_in == 1'b1)
	                    state <= detect;
	                else
	                    state <= idle;
	            end
				
				detect: begin
					if(data_in == 1'b0)
						state <= wait;
					else
						state <= detect;
				end
				
				wait: begin
					if(data_in == 1'b1)
						state <= detect;
					else
						state <= end_state;
				end
				
				default: begin
					state</ports></module>
